entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Spellsquire of Adam Carthalion entrusted with his infant son Jared; later a beggar, killed during Jared's infiltration of Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Commander at the Battle of Aster Fall; Ezer's master.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Son of Adam Carthalion, raised by Ezer.

entities.name: Battle of Aster Fall
entities.description: Battle where Carthalion told Ezer to flee with Jared.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: Place where Ezer and Jared lived as beggars.

entities.name: House Scarlet
entities.description: House that would not accept Ezer and Jared.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: Castle Jared infiltrated to kill Ravidel.

entities.name: House Carthalion
entities.description: House about whose tales Ezer wrote.

events.summary: At the Battle of Aster Fall, Carthalion commanded Ezer to flee with his son Jared.
events.quote: Carthalion commanded Ezer to flee with his son

events.summary: Ezer brought Jared to Arathoxia, where House Scarlet would not accept them, and they lived as beggars.
events.quote: Ezer and Jared lived there as beggars

events.summary: Ezer was killed when Jared infiltrated Castle Melmereth to kill Ravidel.
events.quote: Ezer was killed when Jared infiltrated Castle Melmereth to kill Ravidel
